title: Kicked Malty Juicy Pork Belly Skewers
description: A Kenyan dish featuring pork belly slices smoke-cured to perfection for a solo dinner experience, shojin-friendly and suitable for an iron-teppan.
instructions: Trim the pork belly and score its surface with a sharp knife to enhance flavor absorption.
Mix together salt, black pepper, and your preferred marinade blend in a shallow dish. Season the pork evenly on both sides.
Marinate the pork belly for at least 4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator to allow flavors to penetrate.
Preheat your iron-teppan over medium-high heat until very hot.
Remove the pork from the marinade, allowing any excess liquid to drip off. Do not rinse with water.
Skewer the marinated pork belly evenly spaced on the teppan. Place skewers directly onto the heated surface.
Smoke-cure the pork for about 30 minutes per side or until it reaches an internal temperature of at least 65°C (150°F).
Once done, remove from heat and allow to rest for a few minutes before serving.
